title: Cushion Halo Ring
descriptionHtml:
Cool and bright, built around one clear centre. An 8mm round brilliant clear cubic zirconia sits in four claws at the heart of a cushion shaped pave halo of about 12mm, with pave running down both shoulders and a small opening at the back of the band. The metal is PVD rhodium coated over surgical stainless steel, so the setting reads cool rather than warm. That opening lets it adjust to fit US 5 to 7, and it works as an everyday statement or a proposal style ring.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with cool toned studs and a bare second hand for a balanced look.

Details

  • Size: Adjustable, fits US 5 to 7
  • Stone: Round brilliant clear cubic zirconia, approximately 8mm, four claw set
  • Halo: Cushion shaped pave halo, approximately 12mm across
  • Band: Pave set down both shoulders, open at the back so it adjusts
  • Plating: PVD rhodium coating, anti-tarnish
  • Material: Surgical stainless steel
  • PVD vs plating: Regular plating is a soft layer that wears off over time. PVD is bonded to the metal in a vacuum, so it is far harder, stands up to sweat and keeps its colour much longer.

Care

Waterproof and tarnish free, so daily wear and water are fine. Keep it away from perfume and harsh chemicals, wipe with a soft dry cloth and store it flat in its pouch.

You will receive your piece in a Naira Petite box.

title: Golden Duet Ring

title: Blush Cluster Ring
descriptionHtml:
Soft pink, gathered into a flower. The front of this ring holds a round pink cubic zirconia of about 5mm at the centre, ringed by ten smaller pink stones of about 2.5mm, with one more small pink stone at the other end of the band, just beside it. A slim round shank keeps the whole thing light on the finger. The band is open between the cluster and the small stone, so it adjusts to fit US 5 to 8: a gentle everyday ring with a little colour.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with a soft neutral manicure so the pink cluster stays the brightest thing.

title: Rose Verdant Band
descriptionHtml:
Four fine lines, warmed to rose. This open ring is built from four parallel bands, each one pave set with clear stones across the front of the finger and left plain around the back, with four round emerald green cubic zirconia of about 4mm placed at staggered points. The metal is PVD rose gold coated rather than solid rose gold, and the stones are green cubic zirconia rather than emerald. With an open back that adjusts to fit US 5 to 8, it wears well on its own or beside a plain band.

STYLING TIP: Pair it with rose gold tone studs so the warm finish carries through the look.

Details

Care

title: Granule Dome Ring

A heavy tapered shank carries it, and the open back adjusts to fit US 5 to 8. Wear it alone on the index finger where the texture gets room to read.

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the rest of the hand bare so the dome texture reads clearly.

title: Halo Curve Ring
descriptionHtml:
Two stones that do not match, and that is the point. This solid gold tone band of about 17mm inner diameter carries a natural tiger eye beside a faceted pale champagne crystal, each held in its own irregular bezel shaped to follow the stone rather than correct it. The tiger eye is opaque, banded brown and gold, with a soft moving sheen across it; the crystal beside it is clear and cut. The weight sits solidly across the finger, and the open band adjusts to fit US 5 to 8. Wear it on its own, with the rest of the hand kept bare.

STYLING TIP: Wear it alone on the index finger with bare hands so the two stones stay the whole story.

Details

  • Band: Solid gold tone band, inner diameter approximately 17mm, metal approximately 1.5mm
  • Stone one: Natural tiger eye, opaque with chatoyant banding, approximately 11.8mm
  • Stone two: Faceted pale champagne crystal
  • Setting: Irregular bezels shaped to each stone

STYLING TIP: Wear it with the Droplet Open Cuff in the same metal.

title: Pavé Zigzag Ring
descriptionHtml:

Only the middle stretch carries stones, a single line of eight tiny round clear cubic zirconia, while the steep arms on either side stay plain polished gold. It adjusts to fit US 5 to 8.

STYLING TIP: Stack it beside the Asscher Solitaire Ring, one line next to one stone.

Details

  • Size: Adjustable, fits US 5 to 8
  • Profile: One zigzag with two sharp bends, approximately 9mm tall
  • Stone: A single line of eight tiny round clear cubic zirconia along the middle of the zigzag
  • Band: Approximately 1.5mm
  • Finish: Polished gold tone
